articles.summary: ALEXANDRIA, La., Aug. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Red River Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: RRBI) (the “Company”) announced today that on August 27, 2026, its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend in an amount equal to $0.25 per share of common stock.
articles.title: Red River Bancshares, Inc. Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
